title: Agent regression set
description: The cases a prompt or model change is scored on (examples/evaluation/regressions/manifest.json). Each case is an input, the agent it is for, the behavior expected of the agent and the checks that decide it, with where the case came from. The number of trials and the decision rule are part of the set, so they are written and committed before a run: scripts/evaluate-agents.js --regressions refuses a set with uncommitted changes.

trials.description: k: how many times the agent is run on each case's input.

statement.description: The rule in words, as the report prints it.

block_when_a_case_fails_every_trial.description: Block when any case fails all k of its trials.

block_below_previous_lower_bound.description: Block when the share of cases passing every trial falls below the lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of the previous results for the same scope.

agent.description: The agent run on the input. Its output for one trial is context.json (Analyst), test-cases.json (Test Designer) or candidate.spec.ts (Healer: the test as it left it, unchanged when it declined). Every trial needs its output.

input.description: The case's folder, relative to the set: story.md, context.json and original.spec.ts as the agent needs them, and a README.md saying how to run the agent on it.

expected.description: The behavior expected of the agent, in words.

floor.description: track_floor: the track the runner must hold the story to, from what the Analyst wrote.

text.description: automated_case_for_criterion: a literal (case-insensitive) naming exactly one criterion of the input context.

texts.description: candidate_contains / candidate_omits: texts looked for in the code of the Healer's test, comments excluded.

items.description: A check of scripts/lib/regression-checks.js and its parameters; the evaluator refuses a parameter the check does not take.
